notes.title: Patch 1.1.8 - Important Bugfix for the Dolls and Boiler
notes.notes:
Whilst working on the co-op sequel (KiR: Together) I found a sneaky little bug ('=-' instead of '-=' ah how glorious) which caused an awakened Doll to instantly remove all heat from the Boiler when sabotaging it.
With the fix it's now as it should be: when a Doll sabotages the Boiler it takes one coal out of the Boiler, removing slightly more than the amount of heat one coal would give.

By the way: the Keep It Running: Together Steam store page is awaiting approval by Valve, so it will be online one of these days!

notes.title: Version 1.1.6 - VR, Improvements and Multiplayer Co-op announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello my factory workers,

This is the final big update for Keep It Running, but don't pack your toy boxes just yet because I've started work on the multiplayer sequel to KiR. It is called "Keep It Running: Together" and will feature a bigger (and highly detailed) factory with more things to do and fear, allowing for up to 4 players (or more if applicable).

[b][i]A more detailed announcement will follow once I got some finished things to show off, in the meantime you can check out my Twitter/X for preview screenshots and other goodness :)[/i][/b]

I will still release some minor patches for KiR, as the VR implementation still needs some polishing. However I wanted to get this update out now, since it features some general quality-of-life improvements to the game and I won't have much time to work on it the coming two weeks which would delay the update.

Anyways, here's what is in this update:

[h3][b]Bugfixes and Polishes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed mouse interactions not working when a controller is plugged in,
[*] Fixed Boiler exploding with just 6 coal by making the pressure relief valve stronger,
[*] Fixed Lorry rolling backwards at the beginning of Delivery, causing a Boss voice line ("Turn back!") to wrongly trigger and confuse players,
[*] Lowered Boss anger rate on Day 2 for a better difficulty curve,
[*] Added progress bar to the loading screen,
[*] Game no longer hangs during load, to prevent glitches in VR,
[*] Removed confusing bits on the Ruleboard.
[/list]
[h3][b]VR support:[/b][/h3]
VR is now fully supported, but keep in mind I only have an Oculus Quest 2 so I've not been able to test with other headsets. Please do let me know if you experience issues in the Discussions forum on Steam.
Further more there's some minor polish that still needs doing, such as certain font sizes and subtitles not always appearing correctly. Functionality-wise it should all be there though!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5
notes.notes:
I've worked on the game some more, here's what is updated.

[h3][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Particle effects are now pre-loaded, so there should be no more frame drops when effects happen for the first time during gameplay.
[/list]
[h3][b]Polishes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the Tutorial cutscene with the Demon. I've moved him to a more obvious location, above the machine he breaks. I also added some spark effects to indicate this. This should make things more clear to players,
[*] Made machine malfunction smoke a little bit more obvious by making it lighter as particles fade out,
[*] Added more resolution presets, for higher resolutions and widescreen,
[*] Added drop package animation to the Boss in the Deliveries section of the game.
[/list]
[h3][b]Experimental Xbox & PlayStation controller support:[/b][/h3]
I've added basic controller support, although the game is really designed to be played with a mouse. But for the sake of accessibility and giving players options I felt it was good to implement this regardless.
The menus should all work as well as movement, looking around and interactions.

Since I only have an old Xbox 360 controller here for testing, I've marked this feature as 'experimental' until I've gotten more feedback from players and testers.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 - Various fixes

After having had some great fun watching y'all panic in the Factory and Lorry I've gotten the feedback needed to fix and polish a bunch of things. Lets take a look:
[h3][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with "First Delivery" achievement triggering a day later,

[*] Fixed delivery unlocking when the day before it was also unlocked,

[/list][h3][b]Polishes:[/b][/h3]

There's still a minor bug in the Deliveries section, where the brake or gear select levers will sometimes move in the opposite direction. I'm currently still in the progress of fixing that, as well as adding some small new things to the game.
Of course there need to be more achievements too!

So expect another patch sometime in the coming 2 weeks :)

notes.title: Getting ready for release!
notes.notes:
The new version of Keep It Running for Steam, which includes the new Deliveries update, is almost finished. I'm currently focusing on accessibility, testing, fixing & polishing. The new gameplay is becoming great fun and offers a nice break from toiling away on the Factory floor. Though... It isn't any less stressful with the kind of boss you are working for!

[h3]Accessibility:[/h3]
I'm spending some extra time implementing multiple languages and subtitles, since the game has a pretty strong emphasis on following instructions and reacting to the angry shouts of the Boss.

I've added a language select to the options menu, as well as an option to enable subtitles:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917121/fd066360e3c1305bf10b173de1c2c0cbd38f9713.png[/img]

I lucked out with some people providing assistance with translations, so currently these languages are supported:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917121/a9b2cc577fea32f5a10185a2d0fc6c8c16c13005.png[/img]

[h3]Deliveries:[/h3]
The Factory part of the game has been thoroughly playtested and is currently fully finished, though I may add some small things later on. The Deliveries part of the game is new however and adds fun new gameplay to the game for some extra variety.

In Deliveries you have to control an old steam lorry, which is loosely modeled after the Sentinel brand of steam lorry produced in Britain back in the day:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917121/8b9e53abd756c66254e6abd0b320c8217a8d214b.png[/img]

These hulking, 7+ ton, machines of pure steam power are challenging to control and to make things worse... the Boss is sitting next to you to give you directions and punish you should you get it wrong!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917121/ed29f3cab81504f9bda734f29feaf04b6c812593.png[/img]

The steam lorry has several controls which you have to manage manually, making for some chaotic and fun stressy gameplay. Especially now that I've further tweaked the lorry to feel more scary when barreling down the windy roads of the town. Don't crash or flip it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917121/3561325e4d23b9b36694bcbb3635ccc75500e740.png[/img]

Of course you will be able to unlock Custom Deliveries when you've made it through the entire week, in which you will be able to freely tweak all the parameters to create fun challenges, or maybe to have a relaxing sunday drive through the town?

[h3]Achievements:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917121/494dcf03128463db64c19d95c6a97bf6648cb252.png[/img]
Can't have a survive-the-night game without some fun achievements! I'm adding a plethora of of them, some are easy to get as you naturally progress through the week, others provide extra ways to challenge yourself and go for that completionist streak!

[h3]Release:[/h3]
Currently the game is set to release on the 22th of April, on a Monday. Go wishlist if you haven't already!
